description: This file contains unit tests for the BTreeDictionary class in the com.anysoftkeyboard.dictionaries package. It tests loading, adding, deleting words, and handling of special characters within the dictionary implementation.

classes.name: BTreeDictionaryTest
classes.description: A test class for the BTreeDictionary, containing multiple test cases for dictionary operations such as load, add, delete, and suggestions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the dictionary instance before each test.

methods.name: testLoadDictionary
methods.description: Tests loading the dictionary and verifies the validity of words and internal structure.

methods.name: testLoadDictionaryWithIncludeTyped
methods.description: Tests dictionary loading with includeTyped option and verifies suggestions.

methods.name: testGetWordWithCurlyQuote
methods.description: Tests handling of words with curly quotes and suggestions for partial inputs.

methods.name: getWordsFor
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve suggestions for a given typed word.

methods.name: testAddWord
methods.description: Tests adding new words to the dictionary and verifies internal structure and word validity.

methods.name: testDeleteWord
methods.description: Tests deleting words from the dictionary and verifies internal structure and word validity.

methods.name: assetNodeArrayIsValid
methods.description: Recursive helper to verify the internal structure of the dictionary nodes.

methods.name: testClose
methods.description: Tests closing the dictionary and ensures it becomes invalid afterward.

methods.name: testReadWordsFromStorageLimit
methods.description: Tests loading a limited number of words from storage.

methods.name: testDoesNotAddInvalidWords
methods.description: Ensures invalid words (empty, null, zero or negative frequency) are not added to the dictionary.
